name: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer

fee.note: USD list price plus tax where applicable. Every attempt is paid.

exam.format: 50–60 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 2 hours, online-proctored or at a test center (Pearson VUE since March 2026). English, Japanese, Spanish and Portuguese. No prerequisites; Google recommends 6+ months of hands-on experience with Google Cloud.

scope: Setting up, deploying, operating and securing applications and infrastructure on Google Cloud: projects and billing, compute, GKE, storage, networking, monitoring, IAM.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Google reports pass/fail only and does not publish a passing score.
Certified holders can renew with a shorter renewal exam (1 hour, 20 questions, $75, with its own guide) or through designated courses and skill badges in Google Skills, which add one year.
